mechanism.claim: Within a completed high-variation eight-hour BTC auction, the longest consecutive positive-return run versus the longest consecutive negative-return run measures asymmetric directional persistence that averages and entropy conceal. When the maximum-run asymmetry is historically extreme, follow the longer-run direction for the next eight hours.
mechanism.side: sign(longest positive 5m return run minus longest negative 5m return run)
mechanism.why_distinct: Sign entropy uses only the aggregate positive/negative proportion, serial autocorrelation averages all adjacent products, and directional persistence uses broader path displacement. HVSRAR uses the difference between the two extreme consecutive run lengths, reuses no event set or control, and is not a repair of those terminal candidates.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed-block realized-variation causal rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse conditional 00:05/08:05/16:05 UTC entries with eight-hour holds are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 96 exact coherent BTCUSDT perpetual five-minute aggregates in [D-8h,D), each from five unique 1m rows
features.return_sign: strict sign of each completed 5m log(close/open) return; zero breaks every run
features.positive_run: maximum count of consecutive strictly positive return signs
features.negative_run: maximum count of consecutive strictly negative return signs
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute log(close/open) returns), strict positive
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks of run_share and realized_variation over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 252; current excluded

clock.decision: exact block boundary after all source bars complete
clock.reservation: fixed blocks and holds are nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; funding only after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no block, run definition, rank, history, threshold, side, timing, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
